name: Aldea del Cano (Spain)
description: White field with a red hoist stripe and a red fly stripe each fimbriated white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aldea del Cano (a tower and lions on white and blue).
history: The arms and the flag of Aldea del Cano were approved by the Order of 15 November 2004 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 4 December 2004, after their approval by the municipal council on 25 March 2004.

features.role: Aldea del Cano arms — tower and lions
